auto_validate_on: Orders lock at the carrier on dispatch
auto_validate_off: Orders stay editable until manually confirmed
ecotrack_warning: Recommended: keep auto-validate OFF for ecoTrack-family carriers
from_wilaya_hint: Your warehouse / dispatch wilaya in French
security_note: Credentials are stored encrypted and never returned by the API. Re-enter them each time you update.
stop_desks_empty: No stop desks — sync first from the company page
error_saving: Failed to save changes. Please try again.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
disconnect_confirm_body: The connection will be disabled and the company can no longer be used until you reconnect it.
webhook_unverified_warning: Without a secret, this carrier's delivery events are refused, so its updates do not reach your orders. Add the secret from your Yalidine Webhooks Dashboard.
webhook_url_copy_failed: Copy failed — select and copy manually
webhook_url_hint: Paste this URL when creating the webhook in the Yalidine Webhooks Dashboard. The endpoint answers the validation challenge automatically.
webhook_step_1: Open the Webhooks Dashboard in your Yalidine account and create a new webhook with the URL above.
webhook_step_2: Subscribe to the parcel events: created, edited, deleted, status updated, payment updated.
webhook_step_3: Copy the Secret Key from the webhook's page and paste it below, then save.
webhook_step_4: Activate the webhook — status updates will start flowing into your orders.
webhook_secret_placeholder_set: Secret saved — paste a new one to replace it
webhook_events_hint: Incoming events and their outcomes are visible on the company's page.
zr_webhook_registered_hint: The endpoint is registered at ZR Express and events are flowing. The signing secret is managed automatically.
zr_webhook_off_hint: Registering creates the endpoint at ZR Express and stores the signing secret automatically — one click, no manual setup.
zr_webhook_register_failed: Registration failed — check the API token and supplier permissions
events_empty_hint: Events arrive when the carrier pushes status updates. Register or set up the webhook first — see the credentials page.
zr_mapping_hint: ZR's standard states are already understood. If your account uses its own names, write them under what they mean — comma-separated. A name nobody mapped shows in the inbox as an unknown status, never guessed.
events_retry_ok: Processed — the parcel is up to date
sync_shipments_none: No parcel is on its way with this company
sync_shipments_more: More will be checked next time.
yours_empty_description: Connect a carrier below to send it your orders and follow every parcel from here.
error_endpoint_invalid: Enter the company’s address, starting with https://
error_token_refused: The company refused these credentials. Check the token, the ID if there is one, and the address, then try again.
error_carrier_unreachable: Could not reach the company to check the token. Nothing was saved — try again in a moment.
error_carrier_busy: The company is limiting requests right now. Wait a minute and try again.
token_checked_hint: The credentials are checked with the company when you save.
endpoint_free_hint: Type the address exactly as the company gave it. It is checked when you save.
error_host_refused: That address did not answer like this company’s API. Check it and try again.
places_not_read: {company}'s list of places has not been read yet, so no order can be handed to it. Read it now — it can take up to a minute and a half.
places_explain: Orders go to {company} only in these communes, under its own names; an order anywhere else is refused before anything is sent. The list is read again every week.
places_unmatched_one: {count} place in {company}'s list matches no commune and is never sent to
places_unmatched_other: {count} places in {company}'s list match no commune and are never sent to
places_read_failed: {company}'s list of places could not be read. Reason: {reason}
places_read_keys_refused: {company} refused this API ID or token. Check them, then connect again.
places_read_busy: {company} is limiting requests right now. Wait a minute, then read again.
rates_explain: {company}'s prices for your account, read with its places. A shipment keeps the price of the day it was handed off. This is your cost; what customers pay is set in your shipping profiles. Weight surcharges are not included.
rates_none: {company} gives no prices for your account. Shipments to it are recorded without a cost.
rates_failed: The prices could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
